cases.name: three topics, longer and indented rules
an empty part is left out
only separators: the reply as it is
not a separator: text after the hyphens, a list item, four spaces
a setext heading underline is a separator too
an unclosed code block keeps the rest
the options stay with the last part
a backtick fence with a backtick in its info is no fence
